Her face breaks into a radiant smile. She must be thrilled that her mother's recipe was praised.
Savoring the bento, I express my gratitude once again.

Whoa, no need to push yourself to talk! Were you not feeling well?
Sorry about that, inviting you on such short notice!

(What should I make tomorrow? If I ask Mother,
I'm sure she'll give me another new bento recipe—)

It was a text message from a senior trainer who had helped me in the past.
My stomach is already getting full from the bento, but... I can't turn this down.
Was this her response to me saying "I could eat this every single day"?
...Could it be...

I give my honest impression, saying it has such a gentle flavor
that I could eat it every day. When I do—

"Sounds like you've built a really wonderful relationship with your trainer.
That's truly something to be grateful for."

Ah. I promised to meet up with my friends today, so I should get going now.
Well then, excuse me!

Yeah. So, you see, I really wanted to do something to thank my Trainer...!
But what should I do? What is something I can do...?

Yes. Actually, my mother taught me a recipe yesterday!
So, I wanted you to try it too, Trainer...!
Are you alright~? Were you always such a light eater?

Every single day, there are more things I can do...
It makes me want to try even, even harder.

Nishino Flower bows and jogs away.
While I'm delighted by the bento, isn't it a lot of work for her to make—

Every day...! U-Understood!
Ehehe... I'm so glad you like it.
Ah... yes.

Some time had passed since I became Nishino Flower's trainer.
Training was progressing smoothly, and one day during these fulfilling times...
Finishing every last bite of the bento, I sprinted to the front gate.

"If you make a big deal out of it, they might hesitate to accept, right? ...Ah!
Then how about this?! Don't say it's a thank-you—"
? Is that...
Ah...

Over the meal, I learned so much more about training and interacting with Umamusume.
I'd like to show my gratitude, but... my stomach feels heavy.
How... is it? Is it to your liking...?
Trainer, if you'd like... please have some of this.

Yeah, that's right. Trainer teaches me so thoroughly and gently
that training is just so much fun...!

When I made a bento before, you seemed so happy with it, so... um...
O-Only if it's not a bother, of course...!

...Resolving to at least cover the ingredient costs, I was eating
the bento in the trainer's office when—

Today's bento has my father's favorite dish in it.
I hope you like it too, Trainer...

"Good work today~! Hope you're doing well as always! How about grabbing some food to catch up?
If you're free, let's meet at the school gate!"

Colorful vegetables and simmered side dishes. Fried chicken that's delicious even cold—
Every dish has a gentle flavor, making for a truly comforting lunch.
—The next day.

(...I wonder how today's bento was. Father's favorite dish...
I hope Trainer enjoyed it too.)
